name: XlPivotTableMissingItems
description: Specifies the maximum number of unique items allowed per PivotField.

constants.name: xlMissingItemsDefault
constants.description: The default number of unique items per PivotField allowed.

constants.name: xlMissingItemsNone
constants.description: No unique items per PivotField allowed (zero).

constants.name: xlMissingItemsMax
constants.description: The maximum number of unique items per PivotField allowed (32,500) for a pre-Excel 2007 PivotTable.

constants.name: xlMissingItemsMax2
constants.description: The maximum number of unique items per PivotField allowed (1,048,576) for PivotTables in Excel 2007 and later.
